_comment: Odd-lot tender offer screener. Every threshold below is explained, with its
rationale, in the 'Odd-lot tender screener' section of README.md. Change a
number here rather than in scripts/odd_lot.py — nothing in the code carries
a default that silently overrides this file.
SEC_USER_AGENT (the repo secret) overrides sec.user_agent when it is set.
That precedence is deliberate: the value below is a committed placeholder
and the secret is the real contact address. The SEC blocks an IP for ~10
minutes when the User-Agent is missing or generic, so this is not cosmetic.

_query_terms_note: A phrase search for "odd lot" already matches every document containing
"odd lot holder", "odd lot priority" or "odd lot preference" — those
phrases contain it. Listing them separately doubled the query count and
found nothing new. The hyphenated form is kept because tokenisation of
"odd-lot" is not guaranteed to match the two-word phrase.
